subject: Alignment: ClearPath evaluation orchestration, calendar, and owner commitments
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearpath.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-04T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Alignment: ClearPath evaluation orchestration, calendar, and owner commitments

Hi Elena — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed orchestration calendar so we can lock owners and next steps. I captured the items we agreed and a recommended light-touch cadence to keep the POC moving without adding overhead on your team.

Proposed milestone calendar (4-week window):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): Kickoff + initial data/infra check (45m) — propose Tue Oct 6, 10:00 PT
- Week 1 (Integration sprint): API keys, network allowlist, sample payloads & test harness
- Week 2 (Validation): Run 3 representative scenarios, collect latency/throughput metrics, qualitative output review
- Week 3 (Readout + Decision): Final readout (30–45m) with success scoring and next-step recommendations

Owner roster (Redwood):
- Technical onboarding & integration: Camila Reyes
- Success criteria, acceptance scoring: Grace O'Connor
- Infra, SLA and performance telemetry: Marcus Lin
- Sales / program owner: me (Logan Wright)

Initial success criteria (draft, happy to refine):
1) Functional: 3 priority flows produce acceptable outputs per your rubric (>= 85% pass on validation prompts)
2) Latency: 95th percentile generation under 800ms for typical 256-token prompts
3) Reliability: No more than 2% error rate during validation window

Attachments: CP-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (MAF with milestone checkboxes), evaluation-checklist.md (prompt list + scoring rubric), network-security-snapshot.pdf (what we need from your infra team).

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm kickoff slot or propose an alternative
- ClearPath ops: share network allowlist + any egress constraints before kickoff
- Redwood: finalize calendar invite and share the MAF link (we'll create a shared folder)

Thanks — aiming to have kickoff scheduled by EOD Monday so teams can clear calendars.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Elena Park <elena@clearpath.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearpath.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: ClearPath evaluation orchestration, calendar, and owner commitments

Thanks Logan — appreciate the clear plan. 

Tue Oct 6 at 10:00 PT works for our team — I’ve looped our ops address so they can share the allowlist and our network diagram. High-level success criteria from our side: 
- Accuracy on our two top-priority flows (invoice-parsing & customer-reply drafting) with tolerances we can share (I'll attach).
- No PII leakage; any model-level caching must be documented.
- Observable metrics we can pull into our dashboard (latency, error rate, token counts).

Can Redwood also share your data retention / session logging policy for the trial? We need that for our security review before kickoff.

I attached our evaluation requirements doc (ClearPath-eval-reqs.pdf) and a short internal checklist.

Elena
Elena Park
Director, Product Operations | ClearPath AI
elena@clearpath.ai
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-06T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: ClearPath evaluation orchestration, calendar, and owner commitments

Adding a few technical notes ahead of the kickoff:
- Pre-kickoff checklist I will own: API key exchange, sample payloads, test harness repo access, and a simple smoke test that runs in <24h of access being granted.
- L2 contact on Redwood infra for allowlist/network questions: infra-support@redwood.com (Marcus will monitor).
- We should allocate a 30min engineering touchpoint in Week 1 to validate tokenization/embedding parity on their sample data. I can lead that.

Action items I will take now:
- Post the integration repo link and a minimal README to the shared Drive by EOD today.
- Draft a short runbook for the smoke test and share in the MAF (mutual-action-plan).

Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearpath.ai>, ops@clearpath.ai
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: ClearPath evaluation orchestration, calendar, and owner commitments

Perfect — kickoff invite sent for Tue Oct 6, 10:00 PT (calendar should show "ClearPath — POC kickoff"). Per Elena's ask, attaching our short data-retention summary and session-logging FAQ; what we log during a trial is limited to request/response metadata, timestamps, and telemetry — raw payloads are not persisted beyond the trial unless otherwise requested and tied to an NDA.

Quoting Elena's checklist to confirm items for kickoff:
> - Accuracy on invoice-parsing & reply drafting (they will share tolerances)
> - No PII leakage; model caching documented
> - Observable latency/error/token metrics

Camila: please confirm repo link posted and smoke-test runbook in the MAF before the kickoff. Marcus: please be on the kickoff to confirm how we'll export telemetry into ClearPath's dashboard (Lightweight export or S3 dump is fine).

Thanks everyone — will follow up after the kickoff with the initial integration sprint checklist and the first week's touchpoint calendar.

— Logan
(attachments referenced in-thread: CP-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), evaluation-checklist.md (markdown checklist), network-security-snapshot.pdf (PDF stub), ClearPath-eval-reqs.pdf (external attachment), data-retention-summary.pdf (Redwood policy stub))
